formulas.name: ServiceAppointmentFieldsCreateFormula
formulas.expression:
"{" & "\"AdditionalInformation\":\"" & BLANKVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.AdditionalInformation}, "") & "\"," & "\"AppointmentType\":\"" & TEXT({!ServiceAppointment.AppointmentType}) & "\"," & "\"Comments\":\"" & BLANKVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.Comments}, "") & "\"," & "\"ServiceTerritoryId\":\"" & {!ServiceAppointment.ServiceTerritoryId} & "\"," & "\"ServiceResourceId\":\"" & {!ServiceResourceId} & "\"," & "\"WorkTypeGroupId\":\"" & {!WorkTypeGroupId} & "\"," &
"\"SchedStartTime\":\"" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedStartTime}))) & "-" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedStartTime}))), 2) & "-" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedStartTime}))), 2) & "T" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedStartTime}))), 2) & ":" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedStartTime}))), 2) & ":00.000Z\"," &
"\"SchedEndTime\":\"" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedEndTime}))) & "-" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedEndTime}))), 2) & "-" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedEndTime}))), 2) & "T" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedEndTime}))), 2) & ":" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.SchedEndTime}))), 2) & ":00.000Z\"," &
"\"Description\":\"" & BLANKVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.Description}, "") & "\"," & "\"Subject\":\"" & BLANKVALUE({!ServiceAppointment.Subject}, "") & "\"," & "\"Phone\":\"" & BLANKVALUE({!Lead.MobilePhone}, "") & "\"," & "\"Email\":\"" & BLANKVALUE({!Lead.Email}, "") & "\"," & "\"IsAnonymousBooking\":" & IF({!allowAnonymousBooking}, "true", "false") & "," & "\"isSlotChanged\": false}"
